entities.name: Thrull
entities.description: A creature type for living creatures animated from dead flesh, usually with black mana, often used for ritual sacrifice.

entities.name: Endrek Sahr
entities.description: Creator of the first Sarpadian thrulls as slaves for the Order of the Ebon Hand; his derelor led to an execution order.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Order served by thrulls that is annihilated by them.

entities.name: Reod Dai
entities.description: Visitor who convinced the thrulls to turn on their masters.

entities.name: Jherana Rure
entities.description: Led a counterinsurgency against the thrull army and was killed by thrull assassins.

entities.name: Vaylesh
entities.description: Priestess of the Order who summoned a derelor against the Farrelites.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Planeswalker whose Fireball struck down the derelor.

entities.name: Derelor
entities.description: Endrek Sahr's masterpiece, much larger thrulls needing constant black mana.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Continent where thrulls were first created and now rule.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Only non-thrull life that survived in Sarpadia.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Controls thrulls in Urborg 60 years after the Mending.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose signature race is thrulls used as unthinking servants.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Guild whose thrulls are created using both black and red mana.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Kept thrulls in his Stronghold on Rath.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian whose cultists were at odds with the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane with thrulls serving as receptacles of black mana.

events.summary: Endrek Sahr creates the first thrulls on Sarpadia as slaves for the Order of the Ebon Hand.
events.quote: the thrulls were first created by Endrek Sahr as slaves for the Order of the Ebon Hand

events.summary: Reod Dai convinces thrulls to turn on their masters; they annihilate the Order and wipe out all non-thrull life in Sarpadia except the thallids; Jherana Rure is killed by thrull assassins.
events.quote: annihilating the Order and, save for the thallids , eventually wiping out all non-thrull life in Sarpadia.

events.summary: The Order orders Sahr's execution over his derelor; Vaylesh's derelor is struck down by Tevesh Szat's Fireball.
events.quote: This eventually led to an order for Sahr's execution.

events.summary: The thrulls repel the Phyrexian invaders without planeswalkers and continue to rule Sarpadia.
events.quote: the thrulls became so powerful that they repelled the Phyrexian invaders without the aid of planeswalkers .

relations.quote: the thrulls were first created by Endrek Sahr

relations.note: Thrulls turned on and annihilated their masters.
relations.quote: turned the species as a whole against their masters

relations.note: Signature race used as unthinking servants.
relations.quote: Thrulls are a signature race of the Orzhov Syndicate

relations.note: Led a counterinsurgency and was killed by thrull assassins.
relations.quote: Jherana Rure attempted to lead a counterinsurgency against the thrull army
